detail.longDescription: Ever wondered why so many larvae of insects that eat fruits exit the fruit when immersed under water? It's not because they are suffocating, it's because they become positively phototactic when immersed in water. IOW, while without the immersion, they prefer darkness, but in water, they prefer light. Water immersion triggers a positive phototactic shift in larvae of the sap beetle https:// link.springer.com/article/10.1 007/s13355-026-01004-3 # biology # behavior # science # research # neuroscience
